newsitem.title: USA: Terex agrees to sell Clark unit.
newsitem.headline: Terex agrees to sell Clark unit.

text.p: Terex Corp said on Monday it has agreed to sell Clark Material Handling Co for $139.5 million in cash to CMHC Acquisition Corp, a company formed by Citicorp's Citicorp Venture Capital unit and Clark's management.
The transaction is expected to close in early December. Proceeds from the sale will be used to retire debt.
Proceeds from the sale will be used to offer to redeem Terex's 13.25 percent Senior Secured Notes and reduce overall debt level, the company said.
"We believe that this will result in improved liquidity and profitability," chief executive Ronald M. DeFeo said.

"This sale allows Terex to take an important step forward in its strategy of reducing debt and directing its efforts to its higher margin truck and mobile crane businesses - our priority for 1996 and 1997. As previously stated, interest expense has had a major impact on Terex's bottom line."
